name: Tajikistan

flag.description: Three horizontal stripes of red, white and green, with the white stripe twice as tall as the others, and a gold crown under an arc of seven gold stars in the center.
flag.symbolism: Red represents unity and sovereignty, white purity and cotton, and green the bounty of nature; the crown and seven stars are linked to the people and to traditional ideas of happiness and perfection.

hook: Tajikistan wears a gold crown with seven stars on its wide white band, red on top; Iran puts green on top, and Hungary has no emblem.
trivia: The crown is often linked to a folk etymology connecting the name "Tajik" with "taj", the Persian word for crown.
More than 90% of Tajikistan is mountainous, much of it in the Pamir range.
